rows.concept: Information architecture, card sorting and tree testing
rows.why: Navigation widget recommendations do not establish taxonomy/label discovery or findability evaluation.
rows.scope: Open/closed/hybrid card sorts, taxonomy/label decisions, tree-test success/directness and sample limits; separate nav styling.

rows.concept: Cognitive accessibility and neuroinclusive UX
rows.why: WCAG compliance and readability mentions do not cover dedicated cognitive-use guidance, predictable support, memory demands and participatory validation.
rows.scope: COGA patterns, clear tasks/instructions, memory/attention/executive-function demands, user control and research; no clinical generalizations.

rows.concept: Discovery interviews and contextual inquiry for UX
rows.why: Generic interviewing and expert CTA do not cover user discovery observation, task/context sampling and avoiding solution-leading research.
rows.scope: Interview plans, non-leading probes, contextual observation, behavioral evidence and recall bias; no recruiting or synthesis duplication.

rows.concept: Human-centered design lifecycle and problem framing
rows.why: Frontend reference has aesthetic design-thinking prompts, but no research-led lifecycle, divergent/convergent decision gates or evidence-to-problem framing.
rows.scope: Human-centered lifecycle, problem framing, assumptions and iterative decision gates; do not repeat visual styling.

rows.concept: Moderated and unmoderated usability testing
rows.why: Heuristic evaluation only distinguishes itself from user testing; no full real-user task study execution, moderation, sampling and analysis workflow.
rows.scope: Task/scenario design, think-aloud tradeoffs, moderation, small-sample limits, remote/unmoderated study choice and reporting.

rows.concept: UX measurement, usability metrics and psychometric scales
rows.why: Existing product analytics and generic survey design lack UX outcome frameworks, task metrics and validated usability scales with interpretation limits.
rows.scope: Success/time/errors, satisfaction instruments SUS/SEQ/UMUX-LITE and HEART/GSM; distinguish norms, reliability and inference limits.

rows.concept: UX research strategy and method selection
rows.why: Generic data/research methods do not provide UX-specific discovery/evaluation method choice, triangulation and research-to-decision planning.
rows.scope: Choose generative/evaluative and attitudinal/behavioral methods by risk and question; produce a research plan and triangulation limits.

rows.concept: UX research synthesis, personas and jobs-to-be-done
rows.why: No dedicated UX synthesis chain from observed data to themes, needs, segments, personas and decision-ready findings.
rows.scope: Trace observations to themes and needs, distinguish personas/JTBD, disconfirm themes and preserve minority cases; no fabricated personas.

rows.concept: Inclusive UX research recruitment, consent and ethics
rows.why: Generic sampling/privacy references do not cover disability-inclusive recruitment, incentives, access needs and research recording/retention workflow.
rows.scope: Screeners, representativeness/access needs, recruitment channels, incentives and voluntary consent; jurisdiction-specific legal claims require scoped evidence.

rows.concept: AI-assisted UX research and synthetic participant validity
rows.why: Generic AI analytics/synthetic data do not establish validity of simulated UX participants or provenance-preserving qualitative synthesis.
rows.scope: LLM assistance for planning/coding/synthesis vs replacement participants; empirical validity, bias, traceability and human verification.

rows.concept: Agentic UX oversight, approval and recovery
rows.why: Existing AI chat/streaming guidance does not deeply cover long-running delegated work, plans, risk-based approvals, interruption, undo and recovery UI.
rows.scope: User-visible delegation, progress, scoped approvals, interrupt/cancel, reversible outcomes and failure recovery; avoid backend orchestration.

rows.concept: Design system governance and component lifecycle
rows.why: Existing refs cover tokens and UI patterns, but not contribution criteria, component ownership, adoption, deprecation and accessibility governance.
rows.scope: Contribution/governance, variant/state specifications, versioning, adoption metrics and deprecation; token file interchange is separate.

rows.concept: Design token interoperability, themes and modes
rows.why: Existing token hierarchy guidance lacks interchange format, aliases, composites, modes and round-trip governance.
rows.scope: DTCG design intent/interchange, token types/aliases/composites, themes/modes and portability limits; API syntax only if necessary.

rows.concept: Task flows, wireframes and prototype fidelity
rows.why: Implementation and visual styling exist but no hypothesis-led flow modeling or prototype-fidelity selection and evaluation.
rows.scope: Task/user flows, exception states, wireframes, prototype fidelity, testable hypotheses and handoff boundaries.

rows.concept: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
rows.why: Cross-cultural visual-trust caveats do not provide RTL mirroring exceptions, multilingual text expansion and locale-specific input design.
rows.scope: Layout/text direction, bidi content, expansion, script typography, locale formats and local user validation; avoid API-specific implementation.

rows.concept: Service design, journey mapping and service blueprints
rows.why: Emotional journey curves are a passing adjacent method; no end-to-end service blueprint including backstage dependencies and evidence-backed touchpoints.
rows.scope: Journey maps vs blueprints, frontstage/backstage/support layers, evidence and failure-point validation; avoid inventing personas.

rows.concept: AI-native streaming and generative UI interaction deltas
rows.why: Dedicated May2026 reference exists. Refresh only fast-changing interaction guidance and supported evidence; preserve stable HAX/PAIR foundations.
rows.scope: Current interaction-level streaming/progressive disclosure, uncertainty/citations and failure/fallback practices; no backend/API migration survey.

tree_alias_hits.concept: AI-Native UX and Generative UI Design

rows.concept: DesignOps, developer handoff and design QA
rows.why: Critique reference covers spec-parity checks but lacks operational handoff, decision ownership, delivery feedback and lifecycle design QA.
rows.scope: Decision records, state/spec handoff, acceptance criteria, QA responsibilities, delivery feedback and design debt; separate system governance.

rows.concept: Adaptive and personalized UI user control and evaluation
rows.why: Recommender algorithms cover ranking; current UI guidance does not address interface adaptation predictability, user control and evaluation tradeoffs.
rows.scope: Adaptable vs adaptive interfaces, initiative/control, disclosure/revert and evaluation; do not re-research recommender models.

rows.concept: Participatory design and accessible co-design
rows.why: Critique facilitation is not shared decision-making with affected users; no dedicated co-design protocol or power/representation limits.
rows.scope: Choose participatory roles, accessible workshops, power-sharing, compensation and traceable decisions; distinguish research participation from co-design.

rows.concept: Spatial and multimodal interaction accessibility
rows.why: Vision-language model architecture is not spatial interface design; no dedicated gaze/gesture/voice alternatives, comfort and discoverability guidance.
rows.scope: Spatial input choices, gaze/gesture/voice affordances, equivalent alternatives, comfort and discoverability; platform claims must be scoped.

rows.concept: Content design and in-product UX writing
rows.why: Dedicated microcopy reference covers labels, forms, empty states, onboarding and destructive confirmations.

rows.concept: Deceptive design taxonomies and honest choice architecture
rows.why: Dedicated taxonomy reference is deep and covers prior deferred gap; legal/volatile stamps remain historical. Reuse taxonomy, do not assert current legal status.

rows.concept: Forms, feedback, navigation and error recovery patterns
rows.why: Existing UI/UX catalog and microcopy cover concrete forms/loading/error/navigation patterns; avoid resynthesizing.

rows.concept: Visual hierarchy, typography, color and responsive layout
rows.why: Deep visual rubric, editorial microtypography and UI pattern catalog cover this stable design layer.

tree_alias_hits.concept: Visual Design Principles as a Critique Rubric + Design-Critique Methodology

rows.concept: WCAG accessibility, keyboard navigation and focus
rows.why: Dedicated WCAG2.2/ARIA review reference is present. Cognitive inclusion is a distinct gap below. Existing content retains old verification dates.

rows.concept: Design critique methodology and evidence-based review
rows.why: Deep critique method and rubric exist, with June prior run. Not a missing UXR method.

tree_alias_hits.concept: Visual Design Principles as a Critique Rubric + Design-Critique Methodology

rows.concept: Interaction models, mental models and cognitive task analysis
rows.why: Expert elicitation and interaction heuristics are covered. Reuse stable models; no demonstrated new delta warrants blanket refresh.

rows.concept: Perceived performance, latency feedback and motion
rows.why: Existing AI-native and UI/UX refs cover latency masking, loading feedback, motion and reduced-motion patterns.

rows.concept: Product analytics and causal experimentation
rows.why: Product-analytics and experiment-design references are established. UX psychometrics is separately missing.

rows.concept: AI visual critique and computational aesthetics
rows.why: Deep VLM critique and quantitative-aesthetic references already exist; no new scope justified by map.

rows.concept: Behavioral decision psychology and cognitive load
rows.why: Dedicated applied psychology references already cover decision biases and cognitive load. Reuse stable core; no new claim of freshness.

rows.concept: Brand identity, emotional design and visual trust
rows.why: Dedicated visual-trust reference covers tone, first impressions, brand personality and critique.

rows.concept: Data visualization and analytical dashboard design
rows.why: Dedicated data-visualization method and UI patterns already cover dashboard/chart design.
